item.title: Lee Hyunjung breaks World Cup Qualifiers record with 9 treys in Korea’s win over China
item.description: Korea, Japan, Lebanon, Iran, Saudi Arabia, and Jordan all picked up wins in their respective FIBA World Cup Qualifiers matches

item.title: FEU's Pons-Lopez secures UAAP Beach Volleyball Final Four spot
item.description: FEU clinched a coveted Final Four berth in the UAAP Season 88 Women’s Beach Volleyball tournament after Melody Pons and Lovely Lopez powered the Lady Tamaraws past Ateneo

item.title: UST punches last UAAP Boys Volleyball Final Four ticket, eliminates Adamson
item.description: UST, led by Ranier Lorayes and Chester Esteban, secured the final UAAP Season 88 High School Boys’ Volleyball Final Four berth with a four-set win over Adamson

item.title: ICC secures UCAL women's crown, halts UB's streak in men's finals
item.description: ICC swept the PG Flex-UCAL Season 8 women’s volleyball finals, claiming the crown while their men’s team also forced a sudden-death decider with a dramatic win over reigning champs UB

item.title: Abra trio to finish MPBL commitment first
item.description: SBP has allowed Dave Ildefonso, Geo Chiu, and Jason Brickman to skip Gilas Men’s SEA Games campaign as Abra Solid North pursues the MPBL finals and eligibility issues persist

item.title: Portugal, Japan Cruise into Futsal Women's World Cup KO stage with dominant wins
item.description: Portugal and Japan dominated their final group stage matches, storming into the knockout round of the 2025 FIFA Futsal Women’s World Cup

item.title: NU Pep Squad ninja way to UAAP Cheerdance history
item.description: NU stealthily claimed their ninth UAAP Cheerdance title, becoming the all-time winningest program with a high-risk, ninja-inspired routine

item.title: UP's Gayo-Ornos complete UAAP Women's Beach Volley semis cast, Ateneo's Salarzon-Pacinio, FEU's Salboro-Postorioso make men's semis
item.description: The UAAP Season 88 Collegiate Beach Volleyball Tournament wrapped up the final spots, with UP, Ateneo, and FEU punching their tickets

item.title: Gab Bajacan turns teenage admiration into NU cheerdance triumph over UP and UST
item.description: NU Pep Squad head coach Gab Bajacan: "Ang mga idol ko talaga nung time na nagchi-cheer ako talaga is UST and UP. Kapag nandoon ka sa likod ng classroom, sasayawin mo yung routine nila -- ganon ako ka-fanatic sa kanila noon, while being a cheerleader in FEU."

item.title: Criss Cross claims first Spikers Turf crown in epic five-set thriller over Kindai U
item.description: Fourth time’s the charm for Criss Cross, which finally reached the pinnacle of success by claiming the 2025 Spikers’ Turf Invitational Conference championship in a thrilling five-set showdown
